description: Display of internally illuminated sequential advertisement display capable of static and dynamic content with automatic rotation of images.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed advertising shall operate at an illumination level no greater than 300cd/m2 between dusk and dawn.

The minimum display time for each advertisement shall be 10 seconds, the use of message sequencing for the same product is prohibited and the
advertisements shall not include features/equipment which would allow
interactive messages/advertisements to be displayed. 
Reason: To ensure the proposed sign does not have an adverse effect on the amenity of the area in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 2 - The advertisement hereby approved shall not display any animated or video content unless it is below the VAMM maximum threshold.
Reason: In the interest of highway safety and of the visual amenities of the locality in accordance with the Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 3 - There shall be no special effects (including noise, smell, smoke, exposed cold cathode tubing, flashing, scrolling, three dimensional or intermittent elements) of any kind during the time that any message is displayed. Any animated or video content is not permitted unless it is below the Video Animation Motion Metric (VAMM) maximum threshold. 

The interval between successive displays should be instantaneous (0.1 seconds or less), the complete screen should change, there should be no visual effects (including fading, swiping or other animated transition methods) between successive displays and the display should include a mechanism to freeze the image in the event of a malfunction. 
Reason: In the interest of both highway safety and consideration of neurodivergent users and/or users with sensory processing differences, in line with Policy D5.

Condition : 4 - The minimum display time for each advertisement shall be 10 seconds, the use of message sequencing for the same product is prohibited and the
advertisements shall not include features/equipment which would allow
interactive messages/advertisements to be displayed
Reason: To ensure the proposed sign does not have an adverse effect on the amenity of the area in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 5 - INFORMATIVE: The footway and carriageway on Wandsworth High Street should not be blocked during the advertisement installation. Temporary obstructions during the conversion should be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians or obstruct the flow of traffic on Wandsworth High Street or hinder the operations of buses at the nearby bus stops. All vehicles should only park/stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.
Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE: All vehicles should only park/stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.
